summary_en: Daisue Construction authorized acquisition of up to 176,000 shares (1.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥590.48 million via ToSTNeT-3 on October 16, 2026 at ¥3,355 per share to enable flexible capital policy responses.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 15, 2026, Daisue Construction's Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company authorized the acquisition of up to 176,000 ordinary shares for a maximum total of ¥590.48 million via off-exchange trading (ToSTNeT-3) on October 16, 2026. The purchase price is set at ¥3,355 per share, which was the closing price on October 15, 2026. The authorized shares represent 1.7% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, when 10,297,123 shares were outstanding.

The company states the purpose of the acquisition is to enable flexible implementation of capital policy in response to future changes in operating and market environments. The buy order was placed as a single-session order for the ToSTNeT-3 trading session on October 16, 2026 at 8:45 a.m., with no changes made to the authorized share quantity. However, the company notes that partial or full execution is possible depending on market conditions. The company also noted it had received communication from some shareholders expressing their intent to sell their ordinary shares held in the company.
